proposals.action_title: Upload 10 'Coloring Book' samples to Redbubble (as digital downloads)
proposals.why_this_works_now: Redbubble allows digital product sales. Even if the 'first quality coloring book' isn't fully ready, small, attractive samples (e.g., 5 pages from a future book, or even single high-quality pages) can be sold as instant downloads. This validates the niche and platform without needing a full product. Leverage Pollinations for initial simple images if Together AI/Cloudflare still blocked.
proposals.first_action_today: Select 10 simple coloring page themes (e.g., 'mandala', 'animals', 'geometric'). Generate basic line art using Pollinations. Create Redbubble listings for each as digital downloads priced at 1-2€.

proposals.action_title: Publish 3 'Low Content KDP' books on Amazon KDP (using Pollinations for covers)
proposals.why_this_works_now: KDP is registered. Low content books (notebooks, journals, planners) require minimal internal content generation. The main effort is a good cover and niche targeting. Pollinations can generate abstract or simple graphic covers. This gets products live quickly and starts accumulating sales history.
proposals.first_action_today: Identify 3 simple low-content niches (e.g., 'gratitude journal', 'lined notebook for writers', 'daily planner'). Design basic covers using Pollinations (text2img for abstract patterns/colors, then add text via simple online editor). Prepare KDP listings.

proposals.why_this_works_now: The 'merch_designs' pipeline exists. Even if the image generation isn't perfect, simple text-based or abstract designs can be uploaded to Redbubble on various products (t-shirts, mugs, stickers). This leverages existing tooling and a registered platform without waiting for perfect image quality or a full product launch.
proposals.first_action_today: Run 'produce_merch_designs' pipeline for 20 simple, text-based or abstract graphic designs using Pollinations (or simple online tools). Prioritize evergreen niches. Upload immediately to Redbubble.

proposals.action_title: Affiliate marketing for image generation tools (Together AI/Cloudflare)
proposals.why_this_works_now: Hugo is actively testing these tools. If they prove viable, he can create a simple blog post or social media share about his findings and include affiliate links (if available). This is a low-effort potential income stream directly related to his current work.
proposals.first_action_today: Check if Together AI and Cloudflare Workers AI have affiliate programs. If so, sign up. Draft a short post about 'Solving GitHub Actions Image Generation' with initial findings and affiliate links.

proposals.action_title: Price Experiment: Offer 'Pay What You Want' for a simple digital asset on Itch.io
proposals.why_this_works_now: Itch.io is a platform for digital assets, including game dev assets, and allows 'Pay What You Want' (PWYW) pricing. This can generate initial traction and email list sign-ups even for a basic asset (e.g., a small SVG pack, 3D model, or even a simple coloring page sample). It's a low-barrier way to get first sales and collect feedback.
proposals.first_action_today: Select one simple asset (e.g., 'produce_svg_pack' with 5 basic icons, or a single 'stl_openscad' model). Register on Itch.io. Create a listing with PWYW pricing, suggesting a minimum of 0.50€.

proposals.action_title: Create 5 'Gamedev Asset Pack' listings on Itch.io (basic images/models)
proposals.why_this_works_now: The 'produce_gamedev_asset_pack' and 'produce_godot_assets' pipelines exist. Even simple assets (e.g., abstract textures generated by Pollinations, basic 3D shapes from OpenSCAD, or public domain sprites) can be bundled and listed. Itch.io has a lower barrier to entry than Cults3D for initial sales and can generate early revenue.
proposals.first_action_today: Identify 5 simple asset categories (e.g., 'sci-fi textures', 'basic UI icons', 'low-poly rocks'). Use Pollinations for textures/icons or OpenSCAD for models. Bundle and list them on Itch.io at a low price (1-3€).
